newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy cabinet to examine jobs decree law.
newsitem.headline: Italy cabinet to examine jobs decree law.

text.p: Italy's cabinet will meet on Friday to examine a decree law concerning a package of measures to help ease unemployment, a statement from the prime minister's office said on Thursday.
The decree law is aimed at speeding up investments to create new jobs in a package put together by Labour Minister Tiziano Treu.
Italy's Senate approved the jobs package late on Wednesday after the centre-left government overcame strains with its hard-left Communist Refoundation allies on how to create more jobs.
The Treu bill includes provisions aimed at cutting the working week, introducing more flexible work contracts and boosting apprenticeship schemes.
